name: SQL Injection
description: An attacker may manipulate database queries through unsafe user input.
recommendation: Use parameterized queries instead of directly concatenating user input.

name: Cross-Site Scripting
description: An attacker may inject malicious scripts into web pages.
recommendation: Validate input and encode output before displaying user content.

name: Insecure Authentication
description: Weak authentication mechanisms may allow unauthorized access.
recommendation: Use strong password policies and secure authentication methods.

name: Broken Access Control
description: Users may access resources or perform actions beyond their permissions.
recommendation: Enforce server-side authorization checks for every protected resource.

name: Sensitive Data Exposure
description: Sensitive information may be exposed due to insufficient data protection.
recommendation: Encrypt sensitive data in transit and at rest.

name: Security Misconfiguration
description: Incorrect security settings may expose application resources.
recommendation: Disable unnecessary services and use secure default configurations.

name: Insecure Direct Object Reference
description: Attackers may access another user's data by changing object identifiers.
recommendation: Verify user permissions before accessing requested objects.

name: Cross-Site Request Forgery
description: An attacker may trick an authenticated user into performing unwanted actions.
recommendation: Use CSRF tokens and validate request origins.

name: Weak Password Storage
description: Passwords stored without secure hashing may be exposed.
recommendation: Use Argon2 or bcrypt with appropriate password hashing settings.

name: Insecure Deserialization
description: Untrusted serialized data may execute malicious operations.
recommendation: Validate input and avoid deserializing untrusted data.

name: Server-Side Request Forgery
description: An attacker may cause a server to make requests to internal resources.
recommendation: Validate destination URLs and restrict outbound network access.

name: Path Traversal
description: An attacker may access files outside the intended directory.
recommendation: Normalize file paths and restrict access to approved directories.

name: Command Injection
description: Unsafe input may allow attackers to execute system commands.
recommendation: Avoid shell execution with user input and validate all inputs.

name: Missing Security Headers
description: Missing HTTP security headers may increase exposure to browser-based attacks.
recommendation: Configure appropriate security headers such as CSP and X-Content-Type-Options.

name: Insecure File Upload
description: Unrestricted file uploads may allow malicious files into an application.
recommendation: Validate file types, limit file sizes, and store uploads securely.

name: Insufficient Logging
description: Missing security logs may make attacks difficult to detect.
recommendation: Record security events and monitor suspicious activity.

name: Hardcoded Secrets
description: API keys and passwords embedded in source code may be exposed.
recommendation: Store secrets in environment variables or a secure secret manager.

name: Weak Session Management
description: Poor session handling may allow attackers to hijack user sessions.
recommendation: Use secure session cookies and regenerate session identifiers after login.

name: Cryptographic Failures
description: Weak or outdated encryption may expose sensitive information.
recommendation: Use modern, well-maintained cryptographic algorithms.

name: Unrestricted API Access
description: APIs without proper access controls may expose protected resources.
recommendation: Implement authentication, authorization, and rate limiting.
